title: Per-window local-ancestry Q matrix
description: Long-format ancestry-by-window table. One row per (chrom, window, sample, cluster) quadruple. Used by the local-ancestry scrubber and any analysis module that needs ancestry conditional on genomic position.

cluster.description: Cluster index, 0..K-1. K is run-level metadata.

q.description: Ancestry proportion for this cluster in this window for this sample.
